summary: NextPlat Corp filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on October 6, 2026, announcing completion of its previously disclosed acquisition of an independent pharmacy near Pensacola, northwest Florida. Total cash consideration was $1,485,439 for the pharmacy and inventory; the target generated roughly $5.6 million in sales for the year ended December 31, 2025, was profitable, maintained positive working capital and carried a debt-free balance sheet. No board recommendation, advisor or premium was disclosed. Expected to contribute to the PharmcoRx segment in Q4 2026, expanding Florida footprint. Watch integration execution and margin contribution.
